name: Updates
short_description: Keeps this badge's apps equal to your own app index
long_description: Every hour this badge fetches an app_index.json you publish yourself, compares every version in it with what is installed, and installs whatever is newer. Same index format and same .mpk packages as the built-in AppStore, so nothing here is a private protocol. A failed check is simply retried, so no cold DNS miss can leave the badge stuck waiting.
